units.rawText: The first time you approached me, I was also swinging my Shuten-kiri; you just waited for me quietly until I finished practicing. I'd honestly almost thought that my old master had come to the Cloud because you behaved exactly as he would.

units.rawText: Maybe it was that passing resemblance that led me to open up to you. I talked about my old master, my fears, and my thoughts on the situation we were dealing with...

units.rawText: It's really strange. You don't look like my old master at all, but you have the same aura that makes people open up to you.
